services.name: Spring Break Fishing Camp
services.desc: The Spring Break Fishing Camp at the Carlsbad Lagoon gives campers a fun, hands-on introduction to everything they need to become confident anglers. Throughout the week, they’ll learn how to fish, tie essential knots and rigs, and use different baits and lures while practicing from kayaks, boats, and land. Campers will also learn how to target specific species and understand their habitats and behavior. By the end of camp, they’ll have the skills and experience needed to fish successfully on their own. blurb: The Spring Break Fishing Camp is a 5-day program for children aged 6-14 to learn fishing skills including knot tying, bait and lure use, and species targeting from kayaks, boats, and land. Campers bring their own fishing rod and bait or may purchase them when booking. The camp runs on specific weeks in March and April.
